description: The boot media and device dumps the SDK's environments use that are not SDK sources, each file identified by its SHA-1, from its source where that gives one (MAME's sets do), else of the file the source publishes (ProDOS's release gives only a SHA-256). A set's files are found by hash, whatever they are named, in a target's bootImage folder, the launch's ROM folder where the environment gives one, the folder a set's variable names where it has one, and RETROCORE_CACHE.

media.title: the Commodore 4040 dual drive's ROMs: DOS 2.0 revision 2, the controller's and the GCR PROM
media.for: booting a PET basic target from its 4040 disk
media.source: MAME's c4040 set, with the GCR PROM from its c2040_fdc set

media.title: ProDOS 2.4.3's disk

media.source: the ProDOS 2.4.3 release, ProDOS_2_4_3.po from releases.prodos8.com, which tools/Fetch-M1Dependencies.ps1 fetches and checks by its SHA-256
